acnh.intro: Marina is a normal octopus in the. She first appeared in as an islander, and she appears in all subsequent games as a villager. Her name comes from "marinus," Latin for "of the sea," which relates to her species.
acnh.appearance: Marina is a pink octopus with round yellow cheeks, black eyes that shrink to smaller white pupils when shocked, a tuft of hair on her forehead, and a pink bow perched on the back of her head like a gentle accessory.
acnh.personality: Marina's normal gentleness once read dreamy on the islands — aura comments, wandering thoughts, meditation requests, and furniture aimed at harmony and tranquility. She meditated often, lost in fanciful outlooks that could turn mystical or gently nonsensical, yet always kind when dealing with neighbors she met along the shore. In town life she is friendly and motherly, apologetic when asking favors, easy to befriend, and uneasy around cranky or snooty edges that clash with her spacey calm. Kindness is her default; even eccentric tangents feel sincere rather than performative, and she keeps a very kind personality through every season on your island, daydreams intact and gentle.

villagerInfo.quote: If you can't say something nice, don't say anything at all.
